text: True or False: A CV quantum circuit consisting only of squeezers, beam splitters, phase shifters, and homodyne detection can be efficiently simulated on a classical computer.
explanation: True — this is the CV Gottesman-Knill result (Bartlett-Sanders-Braunstein-Nemoto, 2002): an all-Gaussian circuit keeps a positive Wigner function that evolves as a classical probability distribution, so it is efficiently simulable. Injecting a non-Gaussian element (a cubic gate, a GKP state, or photon counting) is what could make it hard.
